description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act, No. 33 of 2002 (Petroleum Products Licensing Regulations Act, No. 01 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Power and Energy under the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act, establishing a legal framework for petroleum product licensing. It outlines regulatory requirements, compliance standards, and legal procedures for import/export/sale/distribution of petroleum, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
